principles: Gate-consumed workflow facts must be mechanically checked in code, not inferred from prose.
A local host verdict is useful for quorum but must not pretend to be Authority DONE.
Decision-doc changes should be blocked only when the story actually changes docs/requirements/decisions/*.md.
Diagnostics must tell operators exactly which round, host, or digest is missing.
drivers: B-4e06 proved the 3-round 2-host practice exists but is not yet a hard lifecycle rule.
The user explicitly approved turning that practice into a gate.
Existing host_verdict process events already provide a structured fact stream.

options.name: A: DONE guard consumes host_verdict quorum over changed decision-doc digest
pros: Hard-blocks DONE at the lifecycle point where acceptance matters.
Reuses existing process-events host_verdict facts and autopilot_review_submit writer.
cons: Requires a new digest helper and clear diagnostics for operators.
Stories that change decision docs must learn to record host verdicts before DONE.

options.name: B: Only add a validate warning or story_review advisory
pros: Smaller implementation with low risk of blocking existing stories.
cons: Does not satisfy the user request for a hard rule.
Can be forgotten or bypassed after tests pass.

options.name: C: Auto-spawn hosts from story_advance DONE
pros: Could reduce manual steps for operators.
cons: Expands scope into host orchestration, subprocess policy, and failure recovery.
Contradicts this story exclusion: do not auto-spawn hosts.

chosen: A: DONE guard consumes host_verdict quorum over changed decision-doc digest
rationale: Option A is the narrowest implementation that makes the rule real: it consumes structured host_verdict facts at the DONE gate, leaves unrelated stories alone, and gives explicit diagnostics without adding host orchestration or Authority receipt semantics.

preMortem.scenario: Gate blocks every story, even when no decision docs changed.
preMortem.trigger: Changed-file detector treats metadata or unrelated docs as decision-doc material.
preMortem.consequence: Normal Lattice development gets stuck behind irrelevant host quorum requirements.
preMortem.mitigation: Only activate the gate when git diff against main includes docs/requirements/decisions/*.md files; add no-change smoke coverage.

preMortem.scenario: Gate accepts stale host verdicts after decision docs changed again.
preMortem.trigger: Host verdict materialDigest is not compared to the current changed decision-doc digest.
preMortem.consequence: A repaired or expanded decision document reaches DONE using old review evidence.
preMortem.mitigation: Compute a stable current digest over changed decision docs and require every counted PASS verdict to match it.

preMortem.scenario: One host can satisfy both slots in a round by submitting twice.
preMortem.trigger: Quorum counts verdict rows instead of distinct hostId values.
preMortem.consequence: The two-host independence rule becomes fake.
preMortem.mitigation: Group passing verdicts by runId and count distinct hostId values; duplicate host verdicts in the same round count once.

preMortem.scenario: Operator cannot tell how to fix a blocked DONE.
preMortem.trigger: Guard returns only a generic canFinish failure.
preMortem.consequence: Users hand-edit metadata or abandon the flow.
preMortem.mitigation: Expose decision_doc_quorum_check and make DONE failure text include changed files, digest, valid rounds, missing rounds, and suggested autopilot_review_submit command.
